instruction: Set the screen blank delay to 'Never' in the power settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened GNOME Settings, navigated to Power panel, used terminal gsettings commands to list available power keys, found idle-dim, and set it to false. Successfully disabled dim screen when inactive.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GNOME Settings, navigate settings panels, use terminal gsettings commands to read/write system settings, list available gsettings keys
metadata.task_rationale: Same power settings domain but different target: change screen blank delay instead of dim setting. Uses same gsettings interaction pattern.
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting screen blank delay to Never (idle-delay=0). Evaluator checks gsettings value via vm_command_line. Config pre-sets idle-delay to 300 (5 minutes) so agent must change it.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay' to read the screen blank delay setting, which is the correct gsettings key for this task.
Expected value 'uint32 0\n' is semantically correct: idle-delay=0 corresponds to 'Never' in GNOME power settings.
exact_match metric correctly receives the rules dict (with 'expected' key) and compares the getter output against 'uint32 0\n', matching the gsettings output format.
Config pre-sets idle-delay to 300 (5 minutes) ensuring the agent must actively change the value.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (set screen blank delay to Never) is fully verified by checking the gsettings value.
